gloss: to display; to indicate; to show

definitions.gloss: to display; to show; to indicate
definitions.explanation: To make information visible or apparent, especially on screens, labels, signs, or instruments. Widely used in technology contexts for displaying data on a screen.

definitions.gloss: to express; to declare; to manifest
definitions.explanation: To openly show one's intentions, opinions, or feelings. More formal than simply saying or showing.

examples.japanese: {画面|がめん}にエラーが{表示|ひょうじ}された。
examples.english: An error was displayed on the screen.

examples.japanese: {商品|しょうひん}には{原材料|げんざいりょう}を{表示|ひょうじ}する{義務|ぎむ}がある。
examples.english: Products are required to display their ingredients.

examples.japanese: このアプリは{現在地|げんざいち}を{地図|ちず}に{表示|ひょうじ}してくれる。
examples.english: This app displays your current location on a map.

examples.japanese: {意思|いし}を{表示|ひょうじ}する。
{反対|はんたい}の{意見|いけん}を{明確|めいかく}に{表示|ひょうじ}した。
examples.english: I clearly expressed my opposing opinion.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{新|あたら}しい{政策|せいさく}に{対|たい}する{方向性|ほうこうせい}を{表示|ひょうじ}した。
examples.english: The government indicated its direction regarding the new policy.

notes:
Composed of {表|ひょう} (surface, express) and {示|じ} (show, indicate). One of the most common words in technology and computing contexts, equivalent to English 'display' for on-screen content. Also widely used on product labels and in legal/regulatory contexts for required disclosures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画面|がめん}に{表示|ひょうじ}する: to display on screen
- {価格|かかく}を{表示|ひょうじ}する: to display the price
- {表示|ひょうじ}{義務|ぎむ}: labeling requirement
- 非{表示|ひょうじ}: hidden, not displayed
- {表示|ひょうじ}{名|めい}: display name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {表|あらわ}す: to express, represent — broader; can mean expressing emotions or ideas, not limited to visual display
- {示|しめ}す: to show, indicate — more general; showing evidence, direction, or attitude
- {掲示|けいじ}する: to post, put up — specifically for posting notices or announcements on a board or wall
